user.title: Intelbras Allo wT7
user.description:
Connect Home Assistant to your Intelbras Allo wT7 video intercom.

You'll need:
- Your Allo Plus app email and password
- The numeric unlock PIN you set in the app on first use
- The local IP address of your wT7 monitor

After setup, each door becomes a `button.*` entity in HA. One press = one open pulse on the wT7 relay. (Garage gates typically toggle: a second press closes.)

data.monitor_ip: Monitor IP address on local network

data_description.require_pin: Leave enabled (default). Disable only if your model opens the door without a PIN — the field below is then ignored.
data_description.unlock_pin: The numeric unlock PIN set in the app/intercom. Ignored if the option above is disabled.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid Allo Plus email or password.
error.pin_required: Enter the unlock PIN, or turn off "Device requires an unlock PIN" if your model opens without one.
error.invalid_pin: The unlock PIN does not match the device. Use the numeric door-opening PIN you set in the Allo Plus app (not your account login password). If you never set one, configure it in the app first.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Allo Plus cloud or the monitor.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See Home Assistant log for details.

open_door.name: Open door
open_door.description: Fires one open-door pulse on the wT7 for a given lock number. Use it when an automation should not depend on which door entities are exposed.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The Allo wT7 config entry. Omit it if you have only one wT7.

lock_number.name: Lock number
lock_number.description: Which relay to pulse. 1 = social door, 2 = garage gate (or whatever you mapped). Defaults to 1.

send_audio.name: Send audio to the door speaker
send_audio.description: Plays an audio clip through the wT7 door speaker (talk-back), e.g. a recorded message or a text-to-speech phrase. Max 60 seconds. While it plays the doorbell's single video session is used, so the Allo Plus app and the physical intercom are unavailable.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The Allo wT7 config entry. Omit it if you have only one wT7.

media_content_id.name: Audio
media_content_id.description: What to play: an http(s) URL, a media-source:// item (including media-source://tts/... for text-to-speech), a /local/... URL, or a local file path that Home Assistant allows (e.g. /config/www/hi.mp3).
